name: All in One Helpdesk
description:
'The "All-in-One Helpdesk" app offers a robust solution for managing help desk operations effectively. '
        'It provides tools for ticket creation, management, and resolution, enabling organizations to deliver superior customer service.

'
        'Key Features:'
        '1) Access Rights:'
        '   - Configure user-specific access rights for secure and role-based help desk functionality.'
        '2) Helpdesk Tickets:'
        '   - Create, manage, and resolve tickets with advanced search capabilities for quick issue resolution.'
        '3) Helpdesk Teams:
        '   - Form and manage teams to improve task organization and collaboration.'
        '4) Ticket Types and Categories:'
        '   - Define ticket types, categories, and priorities to classify and address customer issues efficiently.n'
        '5) Customer Portal:'
        '   - Provide a dedicated portal for customers to track and manage their tickets, enhancing communication.'
        '6) Ticket Lifecycle Stages:'
        '   - Configure ticket stages and automate notifications for timely updates to customers and team members.'
        '7) Real-Time Collaboration:'
        '   - Enable team members to communicate directly with customers through the ticket interface for instant support.'
        '8) Automated Notifications:'
        '   - Send automated email updates to customers and team members at different ticket stages.'
        'Navigation:'
        '   - Helpdesk → Tickets'
        '   - Helpdesk → Configuration (for setting up teams, stages, categories, and other configurations)'
        'This app streamlines help desk operations, ensuring improved collaboration and exceptional customer support.'

The EG POS Amount to Word module for Odoo is designed to enhance the point of sale (POS) experience by displaying amounts in both numeric and textual formats on customer receipts. This feature provides improved clarity and transparency, making invoices and receipts more user-friendly for both customers and internal users. It caters to businesses that want to improve customer satisfaction by ensuring that amounts are displayed in a dual format, helping avoid misunderstandings. By using this module, businesses can offer dual-format billing, where the total amount due is shown in both digits and words, which is particularly useful in regions where legal or formal documents require amounts to be written in words for verification purposes. This readable invoicing system promotes clearer communication and makes the receipt much easier to understand, particularly for customers who may not be familiar with complex numeric figures. name: Attendance Auto Checkout
description:
The "Attendance Auto Checkout" app ensures that attendance records are accurate by automatically checking out employees who forget to do so. The app helps manage attendance with minimal manual intervention, improving overall tracking and ensuring timely records.
        
        Key Features:
        1) **Auto-Checkout Activation**:
           - Enable the automatic checkout functionality with a simple toggle.
        
        2) **Scheduled Checkout Time**:
           - Configure the exact time for the system to perform the auto-checkout, typically aligned with the end of the workday.
        
        3) **Cron Checkout Indicator**:
           - Easily identify auto-checkouts with a visual indicator showing that the system performed the checkout due to a missed manual action.
        
        This app reduces the risk of incomplete attendance data, streamlines the attendance process, and ensures all employees are checked out on time, even if they forget.

description:
The Vehicle Detail module provides an efficient way to manage auto parts by categorizing them based on vehicle make, model, type, and year. This module is ideal for businesses in the automotive parts industry, offering comprehensive access control, product management, and vehicle associations.

        2) Group Auto Parts by Vehicle Attributes:
           - Organize auto parts by vehicle make, model, year, and type for streamlined management.

        3) Link Auto Parts to Vehicles:
           - Associate specific auto parts with vehicles, simplifying inventory management and sales.

        4) Vehicle Form View:
           - Manage vehicle details and link them to associated auto parts in a structured form view.

        5) Common Products for All Vehicles:
           - Add universal auto parts that apply to all vehicles, ensuring consistency across the inventory.

        6) Vehicle Detail PDF Report:
           - Generate detailed PDF reports of vehicle information and associated parts for easy sharing and record-keeping.

name: Auto Section In Sale Order
description:
The "Auto Section in Sale Order" app allows users to define product sections and automatically assign sale order lines to these sections. This feature enhances the organization of products within sale orders, improving workflow efficiency. Additionally, the invoice structure reflects the same sections as the sale order, maintaining consistency between the order and invoice.
        
        Key Features:
        1) **Section Management in Product and Sale Order Menus**:
           - Define sections for products and create new sections directly from the sale order section menu.
        
        2) **Sectioned Sale Order Lines**:
           - Group products in sale orders under defined sections for better organization.
        
        3) **Auto Section Creation**:
           - Automatically create sections in the sale order lines based on product definitions, eliminating manual setup.
        
        4) **Consistency Between Sale Order and Invoice**:
           - Ensure that the invoice structure mirrors the same sections as the sale order, maintaining consistency across documents.
        
        This app automates the sectioning of sale order lines, providing a smooth and organized experience from order creation to invoicing.
